name: WordClever – AI Content Writer
author: WP Radiant

sections.description:
WordClever AI Content Writer by WP Radiant is a revolutionary plugin designed to simplify and elevate the way you create product content for WooCommerce. Powered by OpenAI’s ChatGPT API, WordClever provides an intuitive solution for generating high-quality, SEO-friendly product descriptions, meta titles, and meta descriptions effortlessly.

Tailored to WooCommerce users, WordClever integrates seamlessly into the product edit page, providing an AI-powered content creation box within the right-hand sidebar. This tool allows you to generate engaging content that aligns with your brand’s tone and messaging, making it ideal for store owners seeking to save time and enhance their online presence.

With its simple registration and login process, WordClever empowers users to create professional-grade content with just a few clicks. The free version offers up to 10 content generation requests, providing a risk-free way to explore the plugin’s potential. Whether you’re launching new products or optimizing existing ones, WordClever is your go-to tool for efficient and effective content creation.

Key Features

AI-Powered Content Creation: Generate engaging product descriptions, meta titles, and meta descriptions using advanced AI technology.

WooCommerce Integration: Works directly within the WooCommerce product editor for a seamless user experience.

Tone Customization: Choose from Formal, Informal, Professional, or Creative tones to match your brand’s personality.

Keyword Optimization: Input target keywords to create SEO-friendly content tailored to your audience.

User-Friendly Design: Easily accessible and intuitive interface designed for all skill levels.

Free Version: Create up to 10 pieces of content to explore the plugin’s capabilities.

Powered by ChatGPT API: Leverages cutting-edge AI technology to deliver high-quality, relevant content every time.

Transform your WooCommerce store with AI-driven content that saves time, improves SEO, and engages customers. Experience the magic of WordClever AI Content Writer today!

Technical Specifications

  • WordPress Version: 5.2 or higher
  • Tested Up To: WordPress 6.6.1
  • PHP Version: 7.2 or higher

sections.installation:
1. Prerequisites:

Ensure that WooCommerce is installed and activated on your WordPress site before proceeding.

2. Installing the Plugin:

o Log in to your WordPress admin dashboard.
o Navigate to Plugins > Add New.
o Search for WordClever AI Content Writer in the plugin repository search bar.
o Click Install Now and then Activate the plugin once the installation is complete.

3. Register and Log In:

o After activation, go to the WooCommerce product edit page.
o Locate the WordClever Box on the right-hand sidebar.
o Click the Register button to create an account or log in if you already have one.

4. Start Generating Content:

o Select the desired content type (e.g., Product Description, Meta Title).
o Enter a keyword to guide the AI and choose the tone for your content.
o Set the number of results (up to 3 per request).
o Click Generate Content and view the AI-generated results directly in the WordClever Box.

5. Free Version Limitations:

o You can generate up to 10 content requests in the free version. Upgrade to the premium version for unlimited content generation (coming soon).

Support:

For assistance or to report any issues, please visit the support forum or contact us directly through our website. We’re here to help!

WordClever AI Content Writer is your ultimate tool for streamlining product content creation and boosting your WooCommerce store’s success. Install it today and experience the power of AI!
